notablePrerequisites: Saproling Burst has at least two fade counters on it.
description:
Activate Saproling Burst by removing a fade counter from it, creating a Saproling creature token.
The Saproling enters the battlefield as a 1/1 Saproling and a Forest land due to Life and Limb.
Evolution Sage triggers, putting a fade counter on Saproling Burst.
Repeat.
